name: DeleteFile
description: Deletes a file from Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and delete files in SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint file URL to delete (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.txt).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the status of the deletion operation. Success indicates the file was removed.
